content:
National Testing Agency (NTA) conducted the All India AYUSH Post Graduate Entrance Test (AIAPGET) 2026 for admission to MD, MS and PG Diploma courses in Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy.

Important Dates

  • Application begin: 10 July 2026
  • Last date and fee payment: 30 July 2026
  • Correction window: 01–02 August 2026
  • Exam date: 22 August 2026
  • Exam city details: 13 August 2026
  • Admit card: 18 August 2026
  • Answer key: 04 September 2026
  • Result: Notified soon

Eligibility and admission

Applicants should hold BAMS, BUMS, BSMS, BHMS or a recognised equivalent qualification with the required internship status as specified in the official bulletin. Admission is to AYUSH postgraduate courses through the applicable counselling authorities.

Exam city examples

Exam centres included cities such as Prayagraj, Agra, Gorakhpur, Bareilly, Jhansi, Kanpur, Lucknow, Meerut, Varanasi, Bikaner, Jaipur, Jodhpur, Kota, Udaipur, Delhi/NCR, Nagpur, Nashik, Pune, Latur and Solapur. Check the official city notice for the complete list.

Use the official NTA and examination-services links below for the answer key, admit card, city details, notices and brochure.
